reflection.assumptions: Pandemic-related changes may have altered clinical work, service delivery, workload, safety concerns, and interactions with patients, requiring health workers to adapt to evolving demands and resource constraints. It is also important to consider how patient perceptions and experiences can vary significantly from healthcare provider perspectives.
reflection.further_consideration: How might the varying interpretations of patient experiences versus provider experiences shape our understanding of healthcare delivery during a pandemic, and what specific elements of these experiences warrant deeper exploration?
